item.wizardrygolems.ring_ancient_emperor: Earth Golemancy summons a terracotta army
item.wizardrygolems.ring_engraved_concre: Earth Golemancy summons two Concrete Golems
item.wizardrygolems.ring_obsidian.desc:
Summon a sturdy Obsidian Golem with Earth Golemancy
Requires a Master Earth Wand
item.wizardrygolems.amulet_gaia.desc: When an Earth Golem is killed, there is a 10%% chance to trigger an earthquake
item.wizardrygolems.ring_glistering.desc: Earth Golemancy always summons a Melon Golem which heals its owner during combat
item.wizardrygolems.ring_forest_guardian: Earth Golemancy summons 2 Log Golems and 4 Leaf Golems
item.wizardrygolems.charm_dried_mushroom: Earth Golemancy summons 3 Mushroom Golems with poisonous attacks. Each golem has 50%% chance to spawn magical mushrooms upon death
When a Lightning Golem dies, a lightning bolt emerges from the sky
item.wizardrygolems.amulet_snare.desc: Earth Golemancy golems leave 1-5 Snare traps behind if killed
item.wizardrygolems.amulet_deathweed.des: 10%% chance to activate Forest's Curse when an Earth Golemancy golem is killed (100%% chance in forests)
item.wizardrygolems.amulet_steaming_neth: Golems summoned by Fire Golemancy will explode when killed
item.wizardrygolems.ring_smoldering.desc: Fire Golemancy will summon a Magma Golem which can split into two when killed
item.wizardrygolems.ring_flame_trail.des: Fire Golemancy minions set the ground under them on fire
item.wizardrygolems.ring_charcoal.desc: Fire Golemancy will summon two Furnace Golems. The Golems must be fed with coal to operate. Every additional fuel after the first one increases the golem's lifetime by 10 seconds
item.wizardrygolems.ring_fire_golem_dura: Your Fire Golems have twice as long lifetime
item.wizardrygolems.ring_flame_golem.des:
Fire Golemancy will summon a Flame Golem
Flame Golems wield powerful fire magic and they can imbue their owner's weapon with fire
Requires a Master Fire Wand
item.wizardrygolems.charm_fire_golemancy:
Being near a Fire Golem while holding a Fire Staff will empower the caster's magic
Requires a Fire Wand
item.wizardrygolems.charm_ifrit_bottle.d: Your Fire Golems gain a Fireskin effect. Being near a Fire Golem while holding a Fire Wand will grant you fire resistance
item.wizardrygolems.ring_frostbite.desc: Your Ice Golemancy golems have 50%% chance to apply Frostbite on hit
item.wizardrygolems.body_frost_cloak.des: Your Ice Golems gain an Ice Shroud effect. Being near an Ice Golem while holding an Ice Wand will also grant you the effect
item.wizardrygolems.ring_permanent_golem:
Causes your next golem summoned by any golemancy spell to have unlimited lifetime.
Limited to one entity at a time
5 minutes cooldown
item.wizardrygolems.ring_snow_golem.desc: Ice Golemancy summons 5 small snow golems
item.wizardrygolems.ring_winter_golem.de:
Ice Golemancy will summon a Winter Golem
Winter Golems are powerful creatures of ice magic that can imbue their owner's weapon with the power of ice
item.wizardrygolems.ring_lodestone_golem: Lightning Golemancy summons a Lodestone Golem, equipped with a ranged attack and the ability to manipulate magnetic forces, attracting or repelling nearby entities. Sneak-casting determines the polarity
item.wizardrygolems.head_maelstrom_golem:
Lightning Golemancy conjures a Maelstrom Golem, armed with the power of lightning magic
Requires a Master Lightning Wand.
item.wizardrygolems.charm_static_aura.de: Your Lightning Golems gain the Static Aura effect. Being near a Lightning Golem while holding a Lightning Wand will also grant you the effect
item.wizardrygolems.ring_spark_golem.des: Lightning Golemancy summons a Spark Golem. Spark Golems deal magic damage that bypasses mundane armor and exhibit high resistance to physical attacks, albeit they are vulnerable to magic
item.wizardrygolems.ring_electric_scatte: Lightning Golemancy summons 5 small Thunderstone Golems if no other golem-type rings are active. All golems leave behind a trail of lingering electricity.
item.wizardrygolems.amulet_broken_ice.de: Ice Golemancy golems have 50%% chance to shatter upon death
item.wizardrygolems.amulet_jagged_sapphi: Ice Golemancy golems have 15%% chance to cast Ice Spikes under their target with each attack
item.wizardrygolems.charm_frozen_mark.de: Ice Golemancy golems spawn ice sigils when they are killed
item.wizardrygolems.charm_living_snow.de: This bottle contains Living Snow that can be placed. Living Snow summons allied Snow Golems if enemies are nearby. The bottle can be recharged at an Arcane Workbench
item.wizardrygolems.head_permafrost_crow: Ice Golemancy summons two permafrost golems that leave a trail of permafrost
item.wizardrygolems.belt_coldlink.desc: Ice Golemancy golems heal you with each attack for a half heart if you have the Ice Shroud effect
spell.wizardrygolems.earth_golemancy.des: Imbue the soil with life energy to form golems.
spell.wizardrygolems.earth_golemancy.low: Only a Master tier Earth Wand can summon an Obsidian Golem
spell.wizardrygolems.fire_golemancy.desc: Draw power from the essence of Fire to create golems.
spell.wizardrygolems.fire_golemancy.low_: Only a Master tier Fire Wand can summon a Flame Golem
spell.wizardrygolems.ice_golemancy.desc: Draw power from the essence of Ice to create golems.
spell.wizardrygolems.ice_golemancy.low_w: Only a Master tier Ice Wand can summon a Winter Golem
spell.wizardrygolems.lightning_golemancy: Draw power from the essence of Lightning to create golems.
Only a Master tier Lightning Wand can summon this golem
spell.wizardrygolems.healing_golemancy.d: Draw power from the essence of Light to create golems.
spell.wizardrygolems.healing_golemancy.l: Only a Master tier Healing Wand can summon this golem
